research_rationale: The original section 4(b) two-year existence term was actually extended by EO12965 to June 29, 1997, by EO13053 to February 28, 1999, and by EO13114 to June 30, 1999. EO12980 and EO13053 make partial membership/administrative amendments rather than ending the whole order. EO13138 section 3(f) revokes the amended order effective September 30, 1999 under section 9; its recital confirms prior committee termination. However, the dossier expressly lacks the named EO12855 amendment. Its actual scope and effect must be read to establish complete earlier clause history, especially administrative provisions; section 4(c) also contains an already executed revocation of EO12737 that must be distinguished from continuing Council duties. Thus neither the original two-year anniversary nor the later formal revocation is asserted as a proved first cessation of every original clause.
unresolved_material_gaps: The named EO12855 amendment is not located in this dossier; its actual text is needed to resolve earlier clause-specific administrative changes and complete lifecycle history.
